title: Pathu Endrathu Kulla
desc: A driving instructor falls for Shakila, an orphan he's escorting from Chennai to Mussoorie, and tries to save her upon discovering the truth about his mission.

title: Penguin
desc: Pregnant woman haunted by nightmares about her missing child goes on a mission to uncover the truth.

title: Marina
desc: Ambikapathy escapes to Chennai to fulfil his dreams and he earns a living by selling goods on a beach. He faces many hurdles along the way but manages to overcome them in his pursuit for happiness.

desc: Two friends find a time machine and use it to pretend to have amazing astrological skills. But things soon turn sour when they unwittingly get involved with a gangster, putting their lives at risk.

title: Sathiya Sothanai
desc: After discovering a murdered villager's body and jewels, Pradeep decides to surrender them to the police.

desc: Narayana attempts to solve the mystery behind the treasure that has gone missing. However, Jayaram, a gang leader, places several obstacles in his way.

desc: Released from jail, Santhana Lakshmi reflects on her traumatic past, contemplating her next steps and seeking direction for her future.

title: Chitralahari
desc: Struggling with personal and professional failures, Vijay seeks a chance to prove himself. Only Swecha believes in him.

title: Veppam
desc: Kartik, raised in the slums by his brother, is an engineering student. His father Jothi, who abandoned his family years ago, takes advantage of Kartik's friend, Vishnu, for a drug peddling assignment.

title: Meegamann
desc: Chitti works for Jothi, a powerful drug lord, and is busy expanding his business and criminal activities. Unfortunately, his trusted assistant, Shiva, has other plans for him.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: As Inspector Athira prepares for her wedding, she investigates the death of her friend Deepa. However, her world is turned upside down when the mystery unravels before her eyes.

title: Black
desc: Aditya is a Police Constable whos life takes a turn when a murder and robbery that take place while he is on duty. Can Aditya manage it all?

title: Bachelor
desc: Confused between lust and love, a modern couple in a live-in relationship face several hurdles as they struggle through pregnancy dilemmas and familial issues.

title: Puthu Arambam
desc: Surya, an IT professional, is wrongly accused of murder and suffers abuse and imprisonment while awaiting his trial.

title: Peela Sampath
desc: Gaali Sampath, a man with a speech impairment, is passionate about acting, which ruins his son Suri's life. As a result, Suri leaves him, prompting him to mend his ways to reunite with his child.

title: Arjun Reddy
desc: Arjun Reddy Deshmukh is a young surgeon with functioning alcoholism and a furious temper. He spirals into self-destruction when he learns that his girlfriend is marrying another man.

title: Revolver
desc: An ex-police officer, recently released from jail for questionable crimes, pursues a determined mission to set things right.

title: Inidhu Inidhu
desc: A group of new students in a prestigious college form a close friendship after being teased by their seniors. As time goes by, many of them form romantic feelings for each other.
